observation: drift worth consolidating has one detectable shape, an unenforced restatement: one value (a literal of 16+ characters, or a set of 3+ members in any form: array, Set, regex alternation, union, object keys, plugin.json) at two or more live sites in two or more files, where no site imports or derives it from another and no test or type holds the copies equal. Two reviewers of commits d50225f7..60704e0d found it in all six fixes; every one of the 24 candidates judged not viable broke one clause (already one symbol, frozen fixture, a value the type checker holds, branches on a value rather than copies of it). Ranking by a one-member difference surfaced the live .jsx drift first (10 of 511 mirror findings). Where a boundary (a plugin's interface, a separate package, an import cycle, untyped code) blocks the import, the fix is a held mirror (a test) and leftover copies sit at the edge of what that test scans (the warning flag still in bench and mods; a second session-id rule, replace(/[^\w.-]/g, "_") at 14 lifecycle sites, which lets .. through). Sibling-function and branch-on-member drift (PR #188, #189) is a different, noisier shape. Selection caveat: the six were chosen by the literal and mirror finders
couldBe: the shape holds generally and a ranked, filtered list with a home check (consolidate by import, else hold by a test) is a backlog the owner acts on more than half the time
the six are selection-biased: these finders chose them, and an owner rating of fresh candidates from the filtered list falls below half
discriminatedBy: build the filtered, one-member-difference-ranked list on main after consolidate-six, have the owner rate its top 10 blind to source, and count how many they would consolidate
